login.hint: Please enter the ID you received from the study team.
login.error_unknown: Unknown participant ID. Please contact the study team.

welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.intro: Thank you for taking part. Please start by reading the information about how the study runs and about the SoSciSurvey questionnaire, then work through it step by step. In the cases you will watch short videos of students working with faulty program code; your task is to identify the problem in each one.

steps.questions: A few questions about you and your background
steps.sosci: The SoSciSurvey questionnaire — it opens in a new tab, and your participant ID is passed automatically
steps.cases: Nine cases, each with a video, a written diagnosis and a think-aloud

welcome.remember: Please remember this ID — you will need it for the questionnaires and to continue later.

pretest.title: Initial questionnaire
pretest.body: Please open the questionnaire on SoSciSurvey and complete it in full. Your participant ID is passed automatically. Return here afterwards.

posttest.title: Final questionnaire
posttest.body: To finish, please complete the final questionnaire on SoSciSurvey. Your participant ID is passed automatically again.

sosci.note: The questionnaire opens in a new tab.

calibration.title: Eye-tracker calibration
calibration.intro: Please sit comfortably and keep your position. A series of dots will appear — look at each one until it disappears.
calibration.no_tracker: No eye tracker was found. The study can continue without gaze recording — please speak to the study manager first.
calibration.poor: Accuracy is low. Please repeat the calibration.
calibration.error_point: Could not collect a calibration point.

case_intro.title: New case
case_intro.body: You are about to see a new video. Watch closely and take notes while it plays.

case_outro.title: Case complete
case_outro.body: Thank you. Please answer a few short questions about this case.
case_outro.body_plain: Thank you. You have completed this case.

video.error: The video could not be loaded.

diagnosis.title: Your diagnosis
diagnosis.prompt: What was the problem? Describe your diagnosis.

think_aloud.title: Think-aloud
think_aloud.hint: Watch the recording and explain to the study manager what you were looking at and why you took your notes when you did.
think_aloud.batch_hint: You will now go through the recordings of the last {{total}} cases, one after another.

questionnaire.unsupported: Question type “{{type}}” is not supported — please tell the study manager.

thanks.title: Thank you!
thanks.body: You have completed the study. You may now close this window.
thanks.next_participant_waiting: Not everything has been saved yet ({{pending}}). Please wait a moment.

session.error: Something went wrong. Please reload the page.
